description: One probe-schedule request for a candidate under an operator numerical suite.

shapes.description: Trusted shapes.json: shape id to its input_kwargs. Never exposed to the candidate.

mode.description: Gate depth. light samples one representative shape plus a rotating one; thorough covers both size extremes plus a rotating middle.

rotation.description: Evidence digest that rotates shape selection across candidates.

framework_key.description: AKA's normalized framework token, lowercase and alphanumeric (Cuda, CUDA C and cuda-c all arrive as cuda). The cuda token keeps the trusted guard profile because it compiles through runtime extension loading.

trust_mode.description: Requested Atrex-Bench guard profile before the framework downgrade.
